headline: **MLB Daily Recap: June 12, 2026**
article:
The Miami Marlins secured a crucial 8-3 victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates, with Liam Hicks leading the charge at the plate. Sandy Alcantara earned the win with 8 strong innings, striking out 7 and allowing 3 earned runs.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, impacting their teams' lineups. Evan Carter has been placed on the 10-day injured list by the Texas Rangers due to a right oblique strain. The Pittsburgh Pirates have also placed Wilber Dotel on the 15-day injured list with a right lat muscle strain. Other notable injuries include Jack Flaherty's left peroneal strain with the Detroit Tigers, Miguel Andujar's left hamstring strain with the San Diego Padres, and Trent Grisham's right hamstring strain with the New York Yankees.

The Chicago White Sox made a significant trade, acquiring RF Nolan Jones and cash from the Cleveland Guardians in exchange for Future Considerations. The White Sox also traded RF Derek Hill and Other Considerations to the Philadelphia Phillies for CF Dylan Campbell and 2B Jose Colmenares. Additionally, the Detroit Tigers acquired RHP Jacob Waguespack from the Milwaukee Brewers.

top_news.title: **Marlins Take Down Pirates 8-3**
top_news.summary: The Miami Marlins secured an 8-3 victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates, with Liam Hicks leading the charge at the plate. Sandy Alcantara earned the win with 8 strong innings, striking out 7 and allowing 3 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Mariners Cruise Past Nationals 10-2**
top_news.summary: The Seattle Mariners dominated the Washington Nationals, securing a 10-2 victory. Bryce Miller led the way on the mound, pitching 8.0 innings with 7 strikeouts and 2 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Padres Fall to Orioles in 7-3 Loss**
top_news.summary: The Baltimore Orioles secured a 7-3 victory over the San Diego Padres, with Gunnar Henderson leading the Orioles' offense with 3 hits, including a home run. Shane Baz earned the win for the Orioles.

top_news.title: **Torkelson's Homer Not Enough as Tigers Fall to Guardians**
top_news.summary: The Detroit Tigers came up short in a 2-3 loss to the Cleveland Guardians. Spencer Torkelson led the Tigers' offense with a home run (11) and 1 RBI.

top_news.title: **Cardinals Take Down Twins 9-6**
top_news.summary: The St. Louis Cardinals secured a 9-6 victory over the Minnesota Twins, with Iván Herrera and Jordan Walker leading the charge for the Cardinals.

top_news.title: **Yankees Take Down Blue Jays 3-1**
top_news.summary: The New York Yankees secured a 3-1 victory over the Toronto Blue Jays, with Cam Schlittler and Kevin Gausman leading the way for the winning team. Jasson Domínguez and Paul Goldschmidt were among the impact hitters in the game.

top_news.title: **Rangers CF Evan Carter Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Texas Rangers center fielder Evan Carter has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a right oblique strain.

top_news.title: **White Sox Acquire Nolan Jones in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Chicago White Sox have made a move to bolster their roster, acquiring outfielder Nolan Jones from the Cleveland Guardians in exchange for future considerations.
